Pull the enabled warehouse modules for a study

Source: R/dw_pull.R
dw_pull.Rd

Executes one query per module named in the study configuration and returns the raw tables alongside a manifest of what was pulled. This is the R port of tp.stXXXX_dwpull.sas.

Usage

dw_pull(config, con, conn)

Arguments

config

A study_config from read_study_config().

con

A DBI::DBIConnection, typically from dw_connect().

conn

Deprecated; use con.

Value

An object of class pull_result: a list with tables, a named list of data frames keyed by each module's output name, and manifest, a data frame with columns module, output, n_rows, n_cols, and pulled_at.

Details

The port is read-only. The SAS templates also upload a cohort table to the warehouse; that write is deliberately not carried here and is deferred to a later slice with its own review.

A module that returns zero rows is an error unless its definition declares it optional. A silently empty module produces a quietly incomplete dataset, which is the failure this package exists to prevent.

See also

dw_connect(), dw_modules(), compare_built()

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("duckdb", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # Synthetic data; no PHI. DuckDB stands in for the warehouse: its in-memory catalog
  # is `memory` and its default schema `main`, so the module SQL's three-part names
  # resolve without SQL Server.
  con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "st1234_cohort", data.frame(masterid = 1:2))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "vw_CardSurg_Base", data.frame(masterid = 1:2, age = c(61, 70)))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "vw_CardSurg_Valve", data.frame(masterid = 1:2, avr = c(1, 0)))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "vw_CardSurg_Cabg", data.frame(masterid = 1:2, cabg = c(0, 1)))
  path <- tempfile(fileext = ".yaml")
  yaml::write_yaml(list(
    study = "st1234", cohort_table = "st1234_cohort",
    warehouse = "memory", view_schema = "main",
    pull_date = "2026-08-04", modules = list("base"),
    varsets = list("core"), derive = list(missing = TRUE)
  ), path)
  res <- dw_pull(read_study_config(path), con)
  res$manifest
  DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
  unlink(path)
}
